doctrine.runtime_claim: CPU import/self-check evidence only unless a contract states otherwise
doctrine.energy_status: MEASURED only when a meter reports a real sample
doctrine.trust_remote_code: Required by Hugging Face Kernels; pin a full revision before loading

kernels.title: Governed signature envelope
kernels.summary: DSSE-style governance predicate signing, verification, and tamper detection.
limitations: Does not establish external public-key provenance.
No independent security evaluation is claimed.
ECDSA signing receipts are not a transparency-log inclusion proof.

kernels.title: Unified governed-kernel suite
kernels.summary: Cross-kernel CPU suite for normalization, advisory Lambda gating, energy honesty, and receipt chaining.
limitations: The bundled self-check is a functional check, not a throughput or accuracy benchmark.
Hugging Face declares no CUDA or ROCm driver family for this artifact.
Cross-kernel receipts have not been independently audited.

kernels.title: Advisory Lambda gate
kernels.summary: Differentiable weighted geometric aggregation with empirical A1-A4 checks and a non-compensatory advisory gate.
limitations: Lambda uniqueness remains Conjecture 1 and is not proven.
The gate is advisory; a host must enforce its result.
Empirical A1-A4 checks do not substitute for the open uniqueness proof.

kernels.title: Governed normalization
kernels.summary: RMSNorm, LayerNorm, fused add plus RMSNorm, optional governance axes, and hash-chained receipts.
limitations: The dedicated GitHub repository is archived; this artifact is retained for compatibility.
Only CPU import and functional self-check evidence is recorded here.
No CUDA, ROCm, latency, or numerical-stability benchmark is claimed.

kernels.title: Governed inference meter
kernels.summary: Policy-gated inference receipts with optional NVML energy measurement and tamper-evident chaining.
limitations: The dedicated GitHub repository is archived; this artifact is retained for compatibility.
Energy is UNMEASURED when NVML is absent and no joule value may be inferred.
The policy gate is advisory unless the host enforces denial.

kernels.title: Fail-closed governed call
kernels.summary: Deny-by-default execution gate, hard security dominance, receipt chain, and Annex IV draft derivation.
limitations: The Annex IV output is a draft skeleton and not legal advice.
The default-deny probe proves refusal behavior only, not policy completeness.
No independent policy audit is claimed.

kernels.title: Provenance controller
kernels.summary: in-toto Statement and SLSA provenance builders with DAG verification, tamper detection, and honest energy states.
limitations: Locally valid statements are not equivalent to independent transparency-log inclusion.
No external verifier or key-distribution system is bundled.
Energy remains unavailable when no real meter is present.

kernels.title: Executable receipt invariants
kernels.summary: Eight falsifiable checks over receipt and ledger JSONL with explicit HOLDS, VIOLATED, and UNAVAILABLE states.
limitations: Executable checks are not Lean proofs.
Ed25519 checks report UNAVAILABLE without a caller-supplied public key.
Only the registered invariants are evaluated.

kernels.title: Bounded Ouroboros accounting
kernels.summary: Bounded loop-tax accounting over recorded provider attempts with terminating, receipt-closed arithmetic.
limitations: Self-check durations are deterministic fixtures, not performance measurements.
Serialization tax is a counterfactual quantity and not a claimed saving.
The kernel does not execute providers or network calls.

kernels.title: Evidence-typed formula registry
kernels.summary: Twenty-one canonical formula records, verbatim proof states, and a tamper-detecting governed-loop composer.
limitations: The executable kernel contains 21 canonical formulas, not the wider research corpus.
Exactly eight records are locked-proven in this artifact.
Lambda uniqueness remains Conjecture 1 and is not promoted by composition.
